_meta.description: EduVora KYC Document Validation Rules for Python Worker.

invalidMimeType.message: Only JPG, PNG, and PDF files are allowed. Please upload a valid document.

invalidExtension.message: The file extension is not supported. Please upload a .jpg, .jpeg, .png, or .pdf file.

mimeExtensionMismatch.message: The file content does not match its extension. Please ensure you are uploading a genuine image or PDF.

numberField.label: Aadhaar Number
numberField.patternHuman: 12 digits. First digit must be 2-9. No letters or special characters.

tooLong.message: Aadhaar number cannot be more than 12 digits.

invalidFormat.message: Invalid Aadhaar number. It must be 12 digits and cannot start with 0 or 1.

allSameDigits.message: Aadhaar number cannot have all identical digits (e.g., 111111111111).

containsLetters.message: Aadhaar number must contain digits only.

validations.reason: UIDAI does not issue Aadhaar starting with 0 or 1
Sanity check for obviously fake numbers like 111111111111

frontImage.label: Aadhaar Card - Front Side
frontImage.description: Upload the front side of your Aadhaar card clearly showing your name, photo, DOB, and the 12-digit Aadhaar number.
frontImage.tipText: Ensure all 4 corners of the card are visible. The image must be clear and well-lit. Do NOT upload a screenshot.

required.message: Aadhaar front side image is required.

backImage.label: Aadhaar Card - Back Side
backImage.description: Upload the back side of your Aadhaar card (optional but recommended).
backImage.tipText: The back side usually contains the address. Upload if available.

uiWarnings.message: For your security, the first 8 digits of your Aadhaar will be automatically masked before storage. Only the last 4 digits will be visible to our team, in compliance with UIDAI guidelines.
The QR code on your Aadhaar card will also be masked automatically to prevent data extraction.

steps: 1. Image received in multer memory (RAM only, never touches disk)
2. jsQR detects and locates the QR code bounding box
4. Fail-Closed Guard: If fewer than 2 digit blocks found, reject with 400
5. First 2 digit blocks (8 digits) are masked with black SVG overlay using sharp
6. QR code area is also masked with black SVG overlay
7. Masked JPEG is saved to disk
8. Original buffer is cleared from memory

failClosedBehavior.trigger: OCR detects fewer than 2 four-digit blocks
failClosedBehavior.userMessage: We could not clearly read your Aadhaar card. Please upload a clearer, un-skewed, well-lit photo of your Aadhaar card and try again.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Hold your phone steady and ensure good lighting. Use a flat surface.
Place the card flat and shoot from directly above.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Glare on the card from reflective surface
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Avoid direct light hitting the card. Move to indirect or diffused lighting.
Place the card on a flat surface and take the photo without holding it.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Virtual or digital Aadhaar mAadhaar screenshot
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Physical card images work best. If using a digital copy, ensure the full card is visible with high resolution.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: PDF format uploaded from scanned document
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: PDFs are accepted but image quality depends on scanner resolution. A clear JPEG or PNG photo is recommended.
Upload the complete front face of the card without cropping any edges.
Tilt the card slightly at an angle to avoid direct glare while keeping it readable.

storageBehavior.purposeNote: Full PAN required for TDS deduction filing under Form 26Q - Income Tax Act

numberField.label: PAN Number
numberField.patternHuman: 10 characters. First 5 uppercase letters, 4 digits, 1 uppercase letter. Example: ABCDE1234F

required.message: PAN number is required for TDS compliance.

tooShort.message: PAN number must be exactly 10 characters.

invalidFormat.message: Invalid PAN format. PAN must be 5 uppercase letters, followed by 4 digits, then 1 uppercase letter. Example: ABCDE1234F

lowercase.message: PAN number must be in uppercase. It has been automatically converted.

informational.note: The 4th character identifies the taxpayer type. For individuals it is P. Use this map to flag suspicious inputs.

frontImage.label: PAN Card Image
frontImage.description: Upload a clear image of your PAN card showing your name, father's name, date of birth, and PAN number.
frontImage.tipText: The PAN number on the image MUST match the PAN number you entered above. Our admin will cross-verify these.

uiWarnings.message: Providing incorrect PAN details will result in TDS credit failure and may lead to account suspension. The Income Tax Department will reject your Form 26Q filing if the PAN is incorrect.
Your PAN card will be reviewed by our admin team to cross-verify your name and PAN number for TDS compliance.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: PAN number entered does not match card image
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Ensure the PAN number you type matches exactly what is printed on your PAN card.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Old or laminated PAN card with worn-off print
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: If the card is very old or damaged, apply for a reprint at NSDL or UTI before submitting KYC.
Upload a clear photo or scan of the original PAN card. Photocopies may be rejected.

numberField.label: Passport Number
numberField.patternHuman: 8 characters. 1 uppercase letter followed by 7 digits. Example: A1234567

tooShort.message: Passport number must be exactly 8 characters (1 letter + 7 digits).

invalidFormat.message: Invalid Passport number format. It must start with 1 uppercase letter followed by exactly 7 digits. Example: A1234567

frontImage.label: Passport - Bio Data Page
frontImage.description: Upload the first page (bio data page) of your passport showing your name, photo, passport number, date of birth, and expiry date.
frontImage.tipText: Only the bio-data page (page 1) is needed. Do NOT upload visa pages. Ensure the MRZ (two lines of code at the bottom) is fully visible.

required.message: Passport bio-data page image is required.

backImage.label: Passport - Back or Address Page
backImage.description: Upload the last page of the passport showing address details (optional).
backImage.tipText: This is optional. Upload if you have it available.

uiWarnings.message: Ensure your passport is not expired. Expired passports will not be accepted for identity verification.
The Machine Readable Zone (two rows of code at the bottom of the bio page) must be fully visible in your upload.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Submit only a valid, non-expired passport. Renew your passport before attempting KYC.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Visa page uploaded instead of bio page
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Upload page 1 - the bio data page with your photo and passport number, NOT a visa page.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: MRZ partially hidden or cut off
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Ensure the two lines at the bottom of the page are completely visible.
Open the passport fully flat. Place it face-down on a scanner for best results.

numberField.label: Driving License Number
numberField.patternHuman: 15 characters after removing hyphens and spaces. Format: STATE_CODE(2) + RTO_DISTRICT(2) + YEAR(4) + SERIAL(7). Example: MH0120240012345. Hyphens and spaces are optional.

tooShort.message: Driving License number is too short. It should be 15 characters after removing hyphens and spaces.

tooLong.message: Driving License number is too long. It should be 15 characters after removing hyphens and spaces.

invalidStateCode.message: The first 2 characters must be a valid Indian state or UT code (e.g. MH, DL, KA, TN).

invalidFormat.message: Invalid Driving License format. Expected: STATE(2) + RTO(2) + YEAR(4) + SERIAL(7). Example: MH0120240012345

validations.check: Remove hyphens and spaces before validation

frontImage.label: Driving License - Front Side
frontImage.description: Upload the front side of your Driving License showing your name, photo, DL number, and validity dates.
frontImage.tipText: Ensure your name, DL number, and the Valid Till date are clearly visible. The image must not be blurry or cropped.

required.message: Driving License front side image is required.

backImage.label: Driving License - Back Side
backImage.description: Back side of the Driving License (optional, shows vehicle categories).
backImage.tipText: Upload the back side if your DL number or important details appear on it.

uiWarnings.message: Ensure your Driving License is not expired. An expired DL will not be accepted.
Learner's Permit (LLR) is NOT accepted. Please upload a permanent Driving License only.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Only permanent Driving Licenses (not LLR) are accepted for KYC.
Renew your DL at the RTO before submitting. Expired licenses are not valid identity proofs.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Old paper or booklet DL pre-smart card
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Old booklet DLs are still valid. Ensure the main page with your photo and DL number is uploaded clearly.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: DL number has hyphens in different positions
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Our system accepts DL numbers with or without hyphens or spaces. Just type all the numbers and letters as they appear.
If your state or UT code is not recognized, please contact support.

numberField.label: Voter ID (EPIC) Number
numberField.patternHuman: 9-10 characters. Standard format: 3 uppercase letters + 7 digits. Some states use 2 letters + 6-7 digits. Example: ABC1234567

tooShort.message: Voter ID number appears too short. It should be 9-10 characters.

tooLong.message: Voter ID number appears too long. It should be 9-10 characters.

invalidFormat.message: Invalid Voter ID format. Standard EPIC format is 3 uppercase letters followed by 7 digits (e.g. ABC1234567). Some states may use 2 letters + 6-7 digits.

validations.note: Lenient regex to support both standard (3L+7D) and state variants (2L+6-7D)

numberField.stateVariationNote: Voter ID formats vary slightly by state. Maharashtra uses a 2-letter prefix. Most other states use a 3-letter prefix. Our system accepts both.

frontImage.label: Voter ID Card - Front Side
frontImage.description: Upload the front side of your Voter ID card showing your name, photo, EPIC number, and address.
frontImage.tipText: Ensure the EPIC number at the top, your photo, and name are clearly visible.

required.message: Voter ID front side image is required.

backImage.label: Voter ID Card - Back Side
backImage.description: Upload the back side of your Voter ID card (optional).
backImage.tipText: The back side typically contains the address and QR code. Upload if available.

uiWarnings.message: Old paper Voter IDs (pre-2015) are still accepted but ensure the EPIC number is clearly readable.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: Temporary or slip voter ID uploaded
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Temporary voter slips are not accepted. Upload only the laminated EPIC card.

commonUploadFailureScenarios.scenario: QR code visible but number unreadable
commonUploadFailureScenarios.frontendHint: Ensure the EPIC number printed at the top of the card is clearly in frame.
If your Voter ID is damaged, apply for a replacement EPIC card at your local BLO or Electoral Office before submitting KYC.

step1_personalInfo.panNumberHint: Enter your 10-digit PAN number (e.g. ABCDE1234F). Required for TDS.

consentText.checkboxLabel: I confirm and consent to the following:
consentText.declarationBody: I hereby voluntarily submit my PAN Card and identity proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / Passport / Driving License) for the purpose of identity verification and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) compliance under the Income Tax Act, 1961. I confirm that: (1) All documents submitted are genuine, valid, and belong to me. (2) I understand that my Aadhaar number will be masked (first 8 digits hidden) before being stored, in compliance with UIDAI guidelines. (3) My PAN number will be stored in encrypted form (AES-256) and used solely for TDS filing under Form 26Q. (4) My other ID documents will be stored securely and used only for identity verification. (5) I acknowledge that providing false or incorrect KYC documents may result in TDS credit failure, account suspension, and legal liability under the Income Tax Act. (6) This consent is given in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

notChecked.message: You must read and accept the KYC declaration before submitting.

backendValidationSync.note: The backend performs these additional checks that are not handled purely by rules:
serverOnlyChecks: File MIME type verification via multer header check
